integrity: General proof plus two standalone finite-instance enumeration verifiers. Independent scholarly validation has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Assumes existence of a finite projective plane of order q>=2; the published optimum palette size is credited to prior work. Applies only to named optimal packing colourings with one-vertex recolouring and without nonoptimal intermediates. Historical priority cannot be proven exhaustively.
title: Star-forest recolouring of optimal packing colourings of projective-plane incidence graphs
